sources.title: Great Wall of China is visible from space: Fact or myth? | - The Times of India
sources.snippet: The enduring myth of the Great Wall of China being visible from space is debunked. Despite its immense length, the Wall's narrow width and similar color to its surroundings make it nearly impossible to see from orbit with the naked eye. Astronauts confirm this, highlighting that modern, larger structures are far more discernible.
sources.quote: If there were an Olympic event for persistent global myths, the claim that the Great Wall of China is visible from space would win gold every single time. True.
